test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a result of the federal form of Government in India?

options.text: Three organs of government - the Legislature, the Executive and the Judiciary
Council of Ministers headed by Prime Minister
Rights of individuals against the State as well as against other individuals
Multi-tiered government - Union, State and Local

solution:
The correct answer is __**Multi-tiered government - Union, State and Local**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **The Legislature**

 
 
• The Legislature is the branch of government responsible for making laws. It is a crucial component of democratic governance and serves to represent the will and interests of the people. In a parliamentary system, the legislature is often bicameral, consisting of two houses. For example, in India, the Parliament comprises the Lok Sabha (House of the People) and the Rajya Sabha (Council of States).
 
 
 
• **Key Functions:**
 
 
• Law-Making: The primary function of the legislature is to draft, debate, and pass legislation. Bill
